Title: MCP Search Tools Current State
Content: MemorySmith.App now exposes POST /api/memories/search/semantic for local semantic baseline ranking, POST /api/memories/search/hybrid for Lucene.NET plus semantic RRF ranking, and /mcp for HTTP JSON-RPC tool access. The MCP tools are memorysmith_search, memorysmith_semantic_search, memorysmith_hybrid_search, and memorysmith_get. .vscode/mcp.json points directly at http://localhost:5089/mcp. The implementation is covered by McpAndSemanticSearchTests, which use copied Data/Memories fixtures so the source project wiki remains stable.
